title: Dow Movers: WMT, BA - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo In early trading on Wednesday, shares of Boeing ( BA ) topped the list of the day's best performing Dow Jones Industrial Average components, trading up 4.7%. Year to date, Boeing registers a 18.5% gain.
And the worst performing Dow component thus far on the day is Walmart ( WMT ), trading down 1.6%. Walmart is showing a gain of 2.1% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Walt Disney ( DIS ), trading down 1.5%, and Apple ( AAPL ), trading up 4.3% on the day.
